body.prompt: On the narrow dirt village road at sunset, the same grandpa from the reference images (white hair, grey flat cap, brown quilted vest) stands alone raising one hand high to wave goodbye toward the distance where a tiny car is disappearing. On a persimmon branch right beside him sits the magpie, also looking down the road. Long shadows, glowing orange persimmons, a few leaves drifting. The magpie is exactly the character in the magpie reference image: a small round chibi magpie with a glossy black head, cream-white face and belly, big shiny dark-brown eyes, short black beak, dark navy-blue wings, a red knotted neckerchief and a small brown leather satchel. It does NOT hold a microphone. It is small, about the size of a sparrow compared with the people. Style: handcrafted 3D miniature diorama photographed with a macro lens, tilt-shift, shallow depth of field, soft cinematic light, felt, clay, paper and wood textures with tiny hand-painted details, gentle film grain, warm nostalgic color grade, clay figurines with soft rounded faces and deeply emotional Pixar-like expressions, not photorealistic. Vertical 9:16 frame, main subject in the middle of the frame, a calm uncluttered area in the top fifth of the frame.
